name: bandit.r050_representative_remote_reach_mcw

steps.label: load_r050_bandit_only_baseline

Original homes/rosters/clocks/history must be unchanged; old roof131,143 is not this source. Geometry alone gives no terrain/emission/reach or gameplay credit. steps.label: native_r050_bandit_only_journey
steps.objective: Use the existing initial field140,138,0 at conservative full-home edge11 (hard10, not default15). Establish real supported elevation/platform and complete charged enabled cone-source setup; no disconnected floodlight or invented cap. A different native continuation qualified source140,138,1 at distance15/cap16: that is a candidate recipe, not this fresh start proof. Keep player near emitting SOURCE and HOME remote, measure actual physical packet and recipient, then follow genuine same-ID scout/report/response/return or exact refusal. No source range tuning, actors/camps/history/report/clock injection. Native setup save/reload must qualify before representative credit.
proof_targets: byte-exact selected fixture and same-run native World/action/quicksave/reload
current roof fire/fuel/weather and physical source-bound smoke packet
added bandit_camp admission, actor IDs, physical scouting/watch/return/report
bandit demand, saved pre-choice boundary and actual peaceful transfer/departure
site-specific saved knowledge, roster, route and supplies without seeded state
graceful game/bridge/launcher closure and saved turns
invariants: offline edits have zero gameplay credit; no injected signal, knowledge, report, raid or payment
the added bandit_camp differs from the inherited distant bandit_cabin and old player lead
do not alter normal supply, response power, drive or dispatch cadence
native scout/response IDs are resolved from this run, never copied from R049

evidence_contract.claim: Explicit hard10-compatible R050 fresh setup at full-home edge11. Native source/emission/reach/adoption and journey must be earned; no evolved journey is copied.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Offline selection and load do not prove smoke admission, scouting, demand, payment or departure.

steps.label: r050_bandit_only_reloaded_world
steps.expected_visible_fact: A native quicksave from this disposable R050 world reloads at its verified saved turn under the same selected immutable executable and profile.

steps.label: verify_r050_bandit_only_saved_reentry
steps.objective: Verify the reloaded native World, effective userdir, saved turn, safe mode and survival setup, then close the disposable process gracefully.
proof_targets: same saved world and confirmed quicksaved turn after process replacement
source-bound selected executable and exact R050 disposable profile
game, bridge and launcher OS exit after the reentry check
invariants: reload begins from the verified native quicksave, without substituting fixture bytes
no fixture reinstall on saved-process reentry
reload alone grants no new faction outcome
